children: Orbit Garant reported Q4 revenue of $57.2M, up 21% YoY, but a Q4 net loss of $1.9M. FY26 revenue hit a record $203.2M, up 7.5% YoY, with a FY26 net loss of $1.5M. It also announced a new specialized contract expected to generate over $100M over five years.
